dress_code.men: Any decent, comfortable clothing suitable for walking and forest environment. Traditional Indian attire (Dhoti, Kurta, Pancha) is widely preferred.
dress_code.women: Any decent, comfortable clothing suitable for walking and forest environment. Traditional Indian attire (Saree, Chudidhar) is widely preferred.

dos: Do take a holy bath in Jampanna Vagu before proceeding for darshan at the Gaddelu.
Do offer 'Bangaram' (Jaggery) to Sammakka and Saralamma Ammavarlu as per your vow.
Do follow designated sector queue lines and follow instructions of police and NSS/NCC volunteers.
Do download the 'Medaram Guide' official mobile app for real-time traffic updates, bus points, and emergency medical help.
Do keep small children and elderly family members tagged with contact information cards/slips.
Follow instructions issued by festival volunteers, police, and administration
Maintain queue discipline during darshan and rituals
Carry valid ID proof at all times
Use designated bathing ghats, toilets, and resting areas
Dispose waste only in marked dustbins
Carry minimum luggage for easy movement
Keep children and elderly under supervision
Stay hydrated and consume safe drinking water
Report lost persons or emergencies at Help Desks
Respect tribal customs, traditions, and rituals
donts: Don't litter plastic bottles, wrappers, or garbage in Jampanna Vagu stream or forest areas.
Don't cross safety barricades or deep water zones at Jampanna Vagu stream.
Don't carry gold jewelry, excessive cash, or expensive valuables into heavy crowds.
Don't attempt animal sacrifices within the main barricaded Gaddelu enclosure (permitted only at designated outer open grounds).
Don't pay money to unauthorized touts claiming to provide fast-track VIP darshan.
Do not litter plastic, food waste, or clothes in forest areas
Do not push, run, or create panic in crowds
Do not consume alcohol, drugs, or intoxicants
Do not damage trees, bamboo structures, or temporary installations
Do not argue with security personnel or volunteers
Do not bathe in unauthorized water bodies
Do not carry sharp objects or hazardous materials
Do not use loud music systems near sacred zones
safety_guidelines: Carrying an extra set of dry clothes and towel is strongly advised. Do not cross safety barricades or deep water zones at Jampanna Vagu stream. Keep small children and elderly family members tagged with contact information cards/slips.
